scenario: Phase1 完成门槛补齐：合同不一致阻流真实预发演练（contract mismatch blocking drill）

environment.gateway_chain: gateway router :8082 /agentengine/api/v1/{RunAgent,SubmitAgentControl,GetAgentStatus} -> agentengine-kernel server admission (digest 校验层) -> runtime /agent-kernel/v1
environment.instance: phase1-canary-1 (agent phase1-canary-agent, tenant phase1-canary, runtime agent-kernel-canary)
environment.auth: api_keys row ak-phase1-e2e-a (bearer key supplied at runtime, never recorded)
environment.no_credentials: no api keys, DSNs, tokens or bearer values recorded

blocking_layer.layer: agentengine-server admission (app/services/agent_control_service.py AgentControlService._admit: instance.contract_digest vs server manifest digest vs runtime-reported digest)
blocking_layer.error_shape: HTTP 200 envelope with Code=409, Data.Error.code=contract_digest_mismatch, retryable=false; per-op audit rows written to agent_control_audits with error_code=contract_digest_mismatch
blocking_layer.runtime_side_note: runtime 自身 /healthz 在 digest 被污染时仍 ready=true（digests_match 仅校验非空）；阻流由 server admission 的 runtime report digest 校验完成，不是 runtime 自拦截
blocking_layer.gateway_side_note: gateway 只透传 server 结论（X-Agent-Kernel-Contract-Digest header 由 gateway lifecycle 注入）；gateway 自身不做目录解析/digest 校验

baseline.note_submitagentcontrol: SubmitAgentControl/GetAgentStatus 经该 api key 解析到 tenant='' 的 auto-created instance ai-f5628db865884d0fabab（bundle unknown），基线即返回 runtime_not_ready 503——预存环境事实，与本次注入无关，已如实记录；digest 阻流证据以 RunAgent + 注入期三动作对比为准

injection_a_server_pg_row.method: UPDATE agent_instances SET contract_digest=64*'0' WHERE id='phase1-canary-1'（psql via ak-pg-0，可恢复）

runagent.message: contract digest mismatch between server and agent instance

injection_a_server_pg_row.forwarded_to_runtime: 无（server logs 显示零次 /agent-kernel/v1 转发，命令未进入 kernel inbox）

injection_b_runtime_report.method: kubectl set env deploy/agent-kernel-canary AGENT_KERNEL_CONTRACT_DIGEST=64*'0' + rollout（更贴近真实路径：runtime health/reporter 链路上报坏 digest）

runagent.message: runtime contract digest does not match server contract

injection_b_runtime_report.which_layer_first: 两层注入均被同一层（server admission）拦截：A 命中 instance-vs-server 分支，B 命中 runtime-report-vs-server 分支；runtime 不自拦，gateway 不校验

metrics.agent_kernel_contract_mismatch_total: 不可得：gateway router /metrics 需 auth context（curl 返回 400/拒绝），gateway-api 无 metrics 路由，server /metrics 无 contract/kernel 指标族。以请求级 409 错误体 + agent_control_audits 六条 error_code=contract_digest_mismatch 审计行为证据

a_restore.action: UPDATE contract_digest 回 canonical 值 @18:14:01Z
a_restore.complication: 恢复后 readiness 短暂 false（lease_healthy=false）——deployed 镜像 fb9113a 早于修复 commit bb2fe85c『renew heartbeat across waiting runs』的已知 bug：waiting run 留在 heartbeat 集合且不再续约；delete pod 重启后立即恢复（修复 commit 描述即『预发需重启 pod 才恢复』）

b_restore.action: set env 回 canonical digest + rollout @18:20:20Z，rollout 完成 @18:20:29Z

recovery.residue: 无环境残留：deployment env 与 PG agent_instances 行均回到 canonical 值；drill 会话数据（cm-drill-*）留存在 append-only kernel 表（按设计不清理）；canary pod 因已知 heartbeat bug 重启过一次

18:20:52Z RunAgent 复测 accepted (cm-drill-recB completed)；环境无残留
